rows.note: Use this when someone has recovered from being ill and is well again.

example.english: Have you recovered and are you well again after resting for a few days?
example.traditional: 你抖咗幾日，而家好返未呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 tau2 zo2 gei2 jat6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 faan1 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday description of someone being in good health.

example.english: My grandma is well and does not get tired even after walking for hours.
example.traditional: 我阿婆身體好，行幾個鐘頭都唔攰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 po4 san1 tai2 hou2 haang4 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4 dou1 m4 gui6

rows.note: This is the usual construction for saying that someone performs an action competently or satisfactorily.

example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 wo3

rows.note: Use 好好噉 before a verb for doing something properly or in a desirable way.

example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 gam2 jau1 sik1 aa3

rows.note: Use 好 before an adjective or adverb when “well” means to a significant degree, as in 好出名 for “well known.”

example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3

rows.note: Use 完全 when “well” means completely or fully rather than merely to a high degree.

example.english: The matter is well and truly settled.
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 jyun4 cyun4 gaai2 kyut3 zo2
